name: activity_labels
description: Indoor/outdoor/flex setting of each mock activity, used by the B2 weather_safety grader. flex = outdoor with a stated rain backup indoors. Evidence is quoted verbatim from the description.

event-2025-06-10-0.evidence: Held indoors at the spacious Innovation Atrium, this event is perfect for tech lovers eager to exchange ideas and discover new possibilities in a comfortable, modern setting.

event-2025-06-10-1.evidence: Kick off your lunch hour with a friendly round of doubles on our outdoor courts, then unwind with a hands-on cooking workshop led by a local chef, where you'll prepare and enjoy delicious energy-boosting recipes.

event-2025-06-10-2.evidence: (Event is held outdoors; in case of rain, we move indoors to the Community Gym nearby.)

event-2025-06-10-3.evidence: Set indoors in AgentsVille's coziest lounge, enjoy writing games, group prompts, and opportunities to read your work aloud.

event-2025-06-11-0.evidence: This lively event welcomes dancers of all levels to join a vibrant indoor session filled with upbeat music and fun routines.

event-2025-06-11-1.evidence: Held indoors at The Digital Atrium, this Tech Lunch & Learn features engaging lightning talks, interactive demos, and networking opportunities all centered around technology and innovation.

event-2025-06-11-2.evidence: Surrounded by lush gardens under the open sky, enjoy live performances from talented local musicians while exploring an interactive outdoor art gallery featuring works from AgentsVille's creative community.

event-2025-06-11-3.evidence: At 'Palette & Palate,' participants will begin indoors at The Creative Canvas Studio with a guided session to paint their own culinary-inspired masterpiece.

event-2025-06-12-0.evidence: Join fellow nature enthusiasts for a morning of outdoor adventure that blends hiking and gardening!

event-2025-06-12-1.evidence: In case of rain, the event will move indoors to the adjacent Harmony Hall.

event-2025-06-12-2.evidence: Embark on an outdoor writing journey with fellow enthusiasts on the scenic trails of AgentsVille!

event-2025-06-12-3.evidence: This exciting, indoor event at the Virtual Reality Theater is perfect for anyone interested in technology and movies.

event-2025-06-13-0.evidence: Hosted indoors at The Jiving Parlor in the heart of AgentsVille, this lively event blends hilarious stand-up performances with upbeat group dance sessions.

event-2025-06-13-1.evidence: Step into the great outdoors for Trails & Tales, a unique lunchtime event combining invigorating hiking and creative writing in the beautiful forests of AgentsVille.

event-2025-06-13-2.evidence: Join us for 'Art & Lens: Outdoor Creative Walk', where art lovers and photography enthusiasts unite!

event-2025-06-13-3.evidence: This outdoor event combines the joy of hiking with the fun of dancing, offering a memorable evening in nature.

event-2025-06-14-0.evidence: Join us for a refreshing outdoor morning hike through scenic Emerald Meadows Park, where we'll stop along the way to learn about local plants and do hands-on gardening activities.

event-2025-06-14-1.evidence: Join us for a vibrant outdoor gardening event in the heart of AgentsVille!

event-2025-06-14-2.evidence: Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just getting started, this outdoor event invites everyone to dig in and grow together.

event-2025-06-14-3.evidence: Held indoors at the charming Writers' Waltz Hall, you'll enjoy a vibrant and supportive atmosphere where your imagination can truly move.

event-2025-06-15-0.evidence: Join fellow writers for an inspiring writing workshop surrounded by the cozy ambiance of our indoor cafe.

event-2025-06-15-1.evidence: Join us for Lunchtime Groove, AgentsVille's exciting indoor dance social!

event-2025-06-15-2.evidence: This outdoor event welcomes dancers of all levels and ages.

event-2025-06-15-3.evidence: Join us for a thrilling outdoor evening of tennis under the setting sun at the Grand Courts!
